author: C++ Weekly With Jason Turner
description:
In this episode Mathieu and Jason are joined by Ryan Keane to discuss his Duck library which allows polymorphism-like behaviour through reflection, along with his journey of learning C++ through exploration of C++26’s reflection mechanisms.

Guest Bio:

Ryan Keane is a second-year computer science student at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and the creator of duck, a C++ reflection library for non-intrusive interfaces. After writing a blog post about the library's internals, he was invited to speak at CppCon and is now collaborating on P4148: Structural Subtyping for C++.
